spec: ISA 0.9 §4.4 K93; §15 MCX operand and phase witnesses
derivation: §5.6 K78: reversed written control order resolves to the same complete control set; the two flips pop at every operand, restoring allocated c=0. Thus CX(c,d) preserves arbitrary borrowed d. The final two flips restore the exact allocation version before qfree.
